title: Life Simulation Games on Mobile: Best Sims-Style Games (2026)
summary: Looking for life simulation games like The Sims on your phone? The best iPhone and Android life sims for building a life, a family or a town of characters.
body_markdown:
**Quick answer:** Life simulation games let you run a simulated life (a home, career, family or town) on your own terms. On mobile, the main options are Sims-style builders like The Sims FreePlay, text life simulators like BitLife, and character-driven sims like Redbean, where you create the residents and watch their stories unfold.


Search “life simulation games” and you’ll mostly see PC and console results. This list sticks to iPhone and Android, and every price below comes from the store listing. For the cozier end of the genre, see our[cozy life sim games guide](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/cozy-life-sim-games/) .


Table of Contents


Toggle


##


What counts as a life simulation game?


#


A life sim simulates everyday life rather than combat or competition. You manage some mix of homes, jobs, relationships, families and routines. Some are detailed and systems-heavy, and others are relaxed and cozy. The common thread is that you’re living a life, not finishing a level.


##


Sims-style life sims on mobile


#


###


The Sims FreePlay


#


This is the best-known Sims game on phones. You create Sims, build and decorate homes, and guide their careers, relationships and families. It’s free to download on both stores. Its Google Play listing shows in-app purchases and ads, and says it requires an internet connection.


###


Avatar World


#


Create characters and play out daily life across a town: homes, shops and hangouts. It’s free to download on both stores, and its Google Play listing shows in-app purchases.


###


Toca Boca World


#


A digital dollhouse where you create characters and act out any story you like. It’s free to download on both stores, and its Google Play listing shows in-app purchases.


##


Text and choice life simulators


#


###


BitLife – Life Simulator


#


You start at birth and make choices year by year (school, careers, relationships) and see where a life ends up. It’s free to download on both stores, and its Google Play listing shows in-app purchases and ads.


##


Character-driven life sims


#


###


Redbean


#


Instead of managing one Sim, you create a whole cast. You give each character a look, a personality and a backstory, place them in a pixel town you design, and watch them talk and form relationships on their own. It’s free to download on the App Store and Google Play. If you’ve wanted something like Tomodachi Life on your phone, start with our[games like Tomodachi Life for iOS and Android](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/5-games-like-tomodachi-life-for-ios-and-android/) , and see[how to play Tomodachi Life on mobile](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/tomodachi-life-living-the-dream-on-mobile/) for what’s actually available.


###


Gacha Life 2


#


Design anime-style characters and build scenes to tell their stories. It’s free to download on both stores, and its Google Play listing shows ads.


##


Farm and town life sims


#


###


Stardew Valley


#


A farm-life RPG with a town full of relationships. It costs $4.99 on both stores. If you want less farming, see[mobile games like Stardew Valley](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/mobile-games-like-stardew-valley/) .


###


Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp Complete


#


Nintendo’s mobile Animal Crossing: decorate, collect and spend time with animal villagers. It’s a $19.99 one-time purchase on both stores.


##


Can you play life simulation games online for free?


#


On phones, the simplest free option is a free-to-download app such as The Sims FreePlay, BitLife, Avatar World, Toca Boca World, Gacha Life 2 or Redbean. These usually have in-app purchases or ads. We don’t recommend unofficial “play online” sites for console games, because they’re often unlicensed or unsafe. If you’re after Tomodachi Life specifically, our[Tomodachi Life on mobile guide](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/tomodachi-life-living-the-dream-on-mobile/) explains your real options. For more free picks, see[free cozy games on mobile](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/free-cozy-games-on-mobile/) .


*Prices and platforms are from the US App Store and Google Play listings, checked October 23, 2026. Store prices can change, so check the listing before you buy. Redbean is our own game. Other game names belong to their respective owners.*


##


FAQ


#


###


What is the best life simulation game on mobile?


#


For a classic Sims experience, try The Sims FreePlay. For quick choice-driven lives, try BitLife. If you want to create a whole cast of characters who live together, try Redbean.


###


Is there a game like The Sims for phone?


#


Yes. The Sims FreePlay is EA’s own mobile Sims game and is free to download on iPhone and Android. Avatar World and Toca Boca World offer a lighter, dollhouse-style take.


###


Can you play life simulation games online for free?


#


The safest free route on mobile is a free-to-download app from the official stores, such as The Sims FreePlay, BitLife or Redbean. Most have in-app purchases or ads.


###


What’s the difference between a life sim and a cozy game?


#


A life sim simulates daily life. A cozy game is defined by a calm, low-pressure feel. Many games are both; see[cozy games where you can customize your character](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/cozy-games-where-you-can-customize-your-character/) .


##


Build your own cozy town in Redbean
